items.title: Counting down the days: State of Crypto
items.description: The Senate is going on its summer break in a week, leaving next to no time left to sort out its remaining priorities in August. And obviously, the fate of Clarity is one of those priorities.

items.title: Why a DeFi platform ditched its consumer app to become the secret backend for tech giants
items.description: Revenue fell from $80 million to $20 million in the bear market. OTC lending at $260 million outstanding is the fastest-growing line, targeting $1 billion by year-end.

items.title: The future of crypto payments won't include on-ramps or bridges, Fun CEO says
items.description: Alex Fine said standalone crypto payment rails are becoming obsolete as platforms shift toward unified funding flows that abstract away blockchain complexity for users.

items.title: The reverse bridge: Crypto meets Wall Street using perps
items.description: Crypto exchanges built perpetual futures for digital assets. Now they are using them to offer 24/7 exposure to stocks, commodities and indexes.

items.title: Unlike the FTX collapse, the $89 million Coldcard exploit has investors sending bitcoin back to exchanges
items.description: The Coldcard vulnerability has smaller bitcoin holders moving funds onto exchanges for safety, according to blockchain analytics firms. This is opposite of the trend seen following the FTX collapse in late 2022.

items.title: Strategy holds STRC dividend at 12%
items.description: Customarily, Michael Saylor and team have lifted the STRC dividend when it trades sizably below par, but not this month.

items.title: Bitcoin cold-wallet attack spreads to 4,500 addresses as losses near $89 million
items.description: Galaxy Research flagged a third wave of sweeps tied to weak Coldcard-generated keys, with the attacker now targeting smaller balances and changing how funds are collected onchain.

items.title: Tokenized stock trading surged 288% in July, but one QQQ token drove most of it
items.description: Without that QQQ token, QQQB, July volume for tokenized equities would be roughly $2.03 billion, about 30% below June’s total.

items.title: Suspected 4th Coldcard attack wave sweeps 389 Bitcoin: Galaxy’s Thorn
items.description: Galaxy research head Alex Thorn warned that unconfirmed transactions may give some Coldcard users a narrow opportunity to save their funds.

items.title: Coldcard exploit sparks Bitcoin flight, ‘bullish’ crypto consolidation: Hodler’s Digest, August 2
items.description: The “sickening” loss of $90 million of Bitcoin from cold storage weighs heavily on sentiment, as the Clarity Act stalls with just five days left to hold a Senate vote.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Strategy leaves preferred STRC dividend at 12% as price still below par
items.description: Investors have previously benefited from a payout boost when the preferred STRC shares traded well below their $100 par value for a month.

items.title: BNB Chain pursues legal action after ex-employee’s memecoin launch
items.description: BNB Chain said a former employee allegedly used a company tutorial wallet to create a memecoin that the blockchain ecosystem says it did not authorize or endorse.

items.title: Trump Media sells another 2,628 BTC, holdings fall to 4,261 BTC
items.description: Trump Media transferred another 2,628 Bitcoin to Crypto.com, bringing its reported sales over seven months to 7,281 BTC and leaving the company with 4,261 BTC in holdings.

items.title: Coldcard hack sparks biggest sub-1 BTC move since FTX: CryptoQuant
items.description: Bitcoin users moved 39,600 BTC in small transactions as the Coldcard hack continued, with researchers warning that the attack remained active.

items.title: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
items.description: A case tied to defunct crypto exchange FTX moves forward, a soldier seeks to dismiss over a Polymarket bet and a former congressman was ordered to pay $35,000 for manipulative trading.

items.title: Trump says Iran talks to resume Monday after calling off planned strikes
items.description: The latest peace proposal calls for warring parties to return to negotiations and continue working out some of the thorny issues that derailed diplomatic efforts.

items.title: U.S., Japan confirm coordinated yen intervention, signal readiness for more

items.title: Oil drops over 4% as Middle East tensions ebb on diplomatic efforts
items.description: Oil prices fell on Monday as investors pared geopolitical risk premiums after U.S. President Donald Trump said he had called off a planned strike on Iran.
